asr.full_text: Hey ya'll, it's the dad of finance and I just wanted to talk to you today about pancake swap and the new calculator tool it has for syrup pools. So when you go into pools on pancake swap dot finance, it has a calculator, now that lets you calculate what's your return on investment will be with that certain token when you stake cake. So, if you have only $50 $100 $500 it usually does the thousand and tells you what it is but if you have 2000 you can calculate it but it has on there, when you calculate it and you put in those amounts it has the one day the seven days the, thirty days and one year return on investment APY. So it's really cool. It's a new feature. Just want to let you know about it and I'm really excited about it and I'll try to show you what it Is in the next video.

Hey ya'll, it's the dad of finance and I just wanted to talk to you today about pancake swap and the new calculator tool it has for syrup pools. So when you go into pools on pancake swap dot finance, it has a calculator, now that lets you calculate what's your return on investment will be with that certain token when you stake cake. So, if you have only $50 $100 $500 it usually does the thousand and tells you what it is but if you have 2000 you can calculate it but it has on there, when you calculate it and you put in those amounts it has the one day the seven days the, thirty days and one year return on investment APY. So it's really cool. It's a new feature. Just want to let you know about it and I'm really excited about it and I'll try to show you what it Is in the next video.
